static_traits.name: Chen Simin
static_traits.social_status: Having supportive family and friends to confide in, but not fully understanding her job-hunting dilemma; Unemployment pressure causing Relationship tension with family and friends
static_traits.medical_history: without similar psychological problems in the past; not yet received psychotherapy before; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic; able to identify and discuss her own cognitive patterns; high cooperativeness, Positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: Although holding a Master's degree, I believe I will never get a 'proper' job; this belief brings hopelessness and a sense of despair.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling support as qualifications still failing to secure Work markedly affects mental health and overall life outlook.
growth_experiences: Starting job hunting after completing a Master's degree, repeated rejections or no replies, pressure markedly rising and triggering financial hardship; the problem worsening over time, Decreased self-confidence; interpersonally, Unemployment bringing Relationship tension with family and friends; in daily life, job-hunting uncertainty disrupting routine and causing Sleep disorder. The client revised resumes multiple times, expanded networks, sought career advice to improve the situation, but negative beliefs persist.

special_situations.event: Receiving rejection letters or not yet being replied to after applying
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not get positive feedback or offers, it proves I am not good enough, and will never find a 'proper job'
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Revises resume, expands network, seeks career advice, strengthens interview preparation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never find a proper job

special_situations.event: Receiving interview invitations but ultimately not yet getting offers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If interviews do not convert to offers, it shows my ability is insufficient, efforts utterly Meaningless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attributing failure to her own inadequacy, further practicing interviews, systematically updating resumes to highlight strengths
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough, interview failure proves I am hopeless

special_situations.event: Noticing many rejections or not-yet-replied messages when checking job-hunting emails or recruitment platforms
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If rejection appears, it means the whole job hunt is failing, other positive signs do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly recalls negative outcomes, ignores positive signals such as interview invitations

special_situations.event: Facing sustained financial pressure and job-hunting uncertainty
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If currently financially tight, it means I cannot be self-sufficient, the future will only get worse
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increases applications and attempts, but inwardly keeps expecting the worst to reduce disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My future has already been ruined

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted; to obtain a stable, decent job to prove her own worth
core_conflict.fear: Fearing continued Being rejected and being judged not good enough, falling into financial insecurity and hopelessness
defense_goal: Lowering expectations by anticipating failure and Self-denial in advance, to avoid bigger disappointment

object_relations.self_representation: An inadequate failure / Being rejected job seeker
object_relations.object_representation: Employers or others are critical judges/rejecters

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counselors or others ask about job-hunting progress, or when talking about Being rejected experiences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to attribute all failure to her own 'not being good enough', and understanding others (including employers) as continuously negating and rejecting her
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle, supportive tone, acknowledges their efforts and situation; guides them to make evidence concrete, distinguish facts from evaluations, reduces self-blame, and invites them to see positive signs at the same time.

manifestations: Feeling the master's study was wasted, efforts utterly Meaningless
Experiencing strong hopelessness and despair when facing job-hunting rejections
Family and friends supportive but not fully understanding her job-hunting dilemma, feeling Relationship tension when communicating

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Insists on the inner standard of 'must find a proper job'
Measures self-worth by socially expected work standards

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-reproach: 'I am not good enough / I am a failure'
Not confident enough in job-hunting and interview exchanges due to Self-doubt

exception_events.target_problem: In job-applying and feedback-waiting situations, the client usually feels despair and Self-denial from frequent rejections or no replies, believing she will never find a 'proper job'.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Receiving interview invitations after several applications, not yet fully negating herself as usual, and admitting that getting interviews means her qualifications were recognized, experiencing some hope.
exception_events.reason: Clues: due to different practices like revising resumes, expanding networks, seeking career advice, opportunities improved, thus the interview invitation deviation.

positive_force: Well educated (Master's degree), holding professional qualifications
Able to take constructive action (revising the resume, expanding connections, practicing interviews, seeking career advice)
Has some social support (family and friends support)
Able to identify and discuss cognitive biases, willing to do reframing and reality testing
negative_force: Catastrophic future predictions and hasty conclusions ('I will never find a proper job')
Mental filtering and negating positive evidence (ignoring the positive meaning of interview invitations)
Self-worth excessively depends on external hiring and others' approval
Sustained pressure causing Sleep disturbed, lowering overall functioning and resilience
Frequent self-reproach and failure identity ('I am a failure')

target_behavior.behavior: Self-denial and strong despair emotions when frustrated by job hunting
antecedent: Receiving rejection letters or not yet being replied to after applying
Interviews not yet converting to offers
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative core beliefs ('I am a failure / I am not good enough') and catastrophic future predictions, generalizing individual rejections into overall failure
target_behavior.function: Avoiding disappointment and uncertainty by lowering expectations, reducing Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem, Reduced motivation, sustained despair, impaired job-hunting efficiency and performance

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep disorder (Difficulty falling asleep or interrupted sleep)
antecedent: Increasing job-hunting uncertainty and financial Rising stress
Repeatedly ruminating on rejections and not-yet replies
target_behavior.core_reason: High stress and Anxiety sustaining negative Automatic thoughts, nighttime rumination enhancing physiological arousal
target_behavior.function: without marked adaptive function (unhealthy physiological reactions)
target_behavior.consequence: Overall health is damaged, daytime energy declines, further affecting job seeking and emotional stability
